test_title: PYST 32: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: LIQM is related to JGOK in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, IFNJ is related to GDLH. To which of the given options is OLTP related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is that each letter of the first term is shifted backward by 2 positions to get the second term. The pattern can be summarized as **(-2, -2, -2, -2)**.

**Pair 1: LIQM : JGOK**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3488aae70355833fc48624ff61f293855aba98dc1097973ce904f6c358a25619.png] 

 

**Pair 2: IFNJ : GDLH**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e3b9f8bffc0ad9266be72cefe385711053eb5ece8ecd865bcce704938c8c24f.png] 

**Applying the logic to OLTP:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87814a618ba6eed0a54b4fc4654f60c675fed17f58063b9c346a1a0a2baf63df.png] 

Thus, OLTP is related to **MJRN**.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4"**.
